sentences.en: Using emotive language can make your speech more persuasive.
sentences.zh: 使用情感化语言可以使你的演讲更有说服力。

sentences.en: The politician used emotive language to appeal to voters' emotions.
sentences.zh: 这位政客利用情感化语言来打动选民的情绪。

sentences.en: Her letter was full of emotive language, trying to evoke sympathy.
sentences.zh: 她的信中充满了情感化语言，试图唤起人们的同情心。
